pr.title: Add radix sort
pr.body:
## 📝 Description

This PR implements the Radix Sort algorithm visualization with the following features:
- Interactive visualization of radix sort with bucket distribution
- Step-by-step execution with detailed progress tracking
- Visualization of digit-by-digit sorting process
- Performance metrics tracking (comparisons and swaps)
- Code highlighting synchronized with execution steps
- Dark/Light theme compatible visualization

## 🎯 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [x] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update

## 🧪 Testing

- [x] I have tested this code locally
- [x] All existing tests pass
- [ ] I have added new tests (if applicable)
- [x] The build completes successfully
- [x] I have tested on multiple browsers/devices (if UI change)

**Test Steps:**
1. Navigate to /algorithm/radix-sort
2. Test with various input arrays (including default: 170,45,75,90,802,24,2,66)
3. Verify correct digit-by-digit sorting visualization
4. Test visualization controls (play, pause, step, speed)
5. Verify sorting correctness and step descriptions

## ℹ️ Summary of Added Workflows

**Added Files:**
- app/algorithms/radix-sort.ts (Algorithm implementation)
- app/algorithm/radix-sort/page.tsx (Visualization page)

**Modified Files:**
N/A

**Purpose:**
- Add interactive visualization for Radix Sort algorithm
- Enhance algorithm learning experience with step-by-step visualization
- Provide educational tool for understanding non-comparative sorting

- Comprehensive step tracking with comparisons and swaps
